create_collision_shape: create a collision shape using pybullet with GEOM_SPHERE, GEOM_BOX, or GEOM_MESH geometry types
create_multibody_obstacle_course: create a multi-body obstacle course with box segments placed at alternating heights and positions
change_dynamics_friction: change the dynamics of a body to set spinning friction, rolling friction, and linear damping values
set_joint_motor_velocity: set joint motor control on a multi-body link using VELOCITY_CONTROL with a target velocity and force
step_simulation_loop: run a simulation loop that steps physics, captures camera images, and reads keyboard events
